Events

Piedmont Avenue Branch library events

Piedmont Post · October 7, 2026 · 2 min read

Chair Yoga

Thursday, October 8 — 10:30 – 11:30 a.m.

Chair yoga is designed for those who have difficulty getting up and down from the floor due to arthritis, knee injury, back pain or any other reason.

Learn from a certified yoga instructor how a daily practice will improve your strength, flexibility, and balance. Meditation elements are included to help you develop greater body awareness and to help you set your intention before the class.

Taught by local instructor Bett Bollhoefer, who is certified in Radiant Body Yoga.

Coffee with a Cop

Saturday, October 10 — 11:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m.

Join your neighbors and public servants for coffee & conversation! No agenda or speeches—just a chance to ask questions, voice concerns, and get to know the beat officers in your neighborhood.

Featuring complimentary café-style beverages from Goldfish Coffee Company’s mobile barista cart, including hot and iced espresso drinks, tea lattes (including matcha, hojicha, and London Fog), hot chocolate, lemonade, flavored steamers, and your choice of dairy or plant-based milk.

All are welcome!

Knitting & Crochet Circle with Susan Segal!

Monday, October 12 — 11:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.

Join us every second and fourth Monday of the month for a delightful early afternoon of yarn, needles, and good company at our Adult Knitting & Crochet Circle!

Settle into a warm and inviting space where creativity and conversation intertwine.

If you need assistance with anything or have questions, Susan is here to help. Join us and make the most of your knitting/cro-chet experience with us! What to Bring:

  • Your current knitting or crochet project
  • Your preferred yarn and needles/hooks
  • A smile and a willingness to connect with fellow crafters Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting, everyone is welcome!

While we’d love to accommodate everyone, keep in mind that space availability will be on a first-come, first-served basis.

Toddler Storytime

Tuesday, October 13 — 10:15 – 10:30 a.m.

Songs, active rhymes and stories especially for ages 18 months to 3 years. Every Tuesday morning at 10:15 a.m.

Stay and play after Storytime with fun age-appropriate toys through 11:15 a.m. If conditions allow, Storytime will be held outside the library building.

We ask that patrons refrain from wearing scented products.

Teen Pop Up Crafts

Tuesday, October 13 — 3:30 – 4:30 p.m.

Teens! Come and hang out and get creative with us every 2nd and 4th Tuesday of the month.

PIEDMONT AVENUE BRANCH

80 Echo Avenue, Oakland, California 94611 Phone: (510) 597-5011
